items.title: Deadly flooding forces evacuations in Southwest as storm shifts east for Election Day
items.brief: A storm causing historic flooding, evacuations and rescues in the Southwest is now pushing into the central United States, where it will bring soggy weather on Election Day on Tuesday.

items.title: US military conducts strikes on Iran’s Qeshm Island in defensive operation, officials say
items.brief: The US military carried out limited strikes on Iran’s Qeshm Island on Monday, three US officials told CNN, characterizing the action as defensive in nature and meant to protect US assets in the region.
